role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero mechanism gate for a deterministic observation/geometry-only nonlinear active-support correction. It is not a rerun or tolerance relaxation of v256, a pyramid, endpoint blend, global low-rank repair, graph diffusion, Haar shrinkage, line/block preconditioner, learned model, or truth-selected support.
scientific_question: Can a support selected only from the current reported-geometry K1 state concentrate a fixed correction solve on the observable plume region, then hand the result to one unchanged full-field Jacobi-PCGLS iteration, while preserving all K16-matched field, gradient and observation gates with fewer exact A and A^T calls?
physical_hypothesis: The Case 19 frame-zero blocker is caused by early Krylov work dispersing into weakly observable background rather than by absent global depth. A deterministic geometry-whitened K1 energy support can focus a solver-native correction on the currently observable active plume without reading truth, time, rig labels or metrics.
design_evidence_boundary: Case 19 and v244-v256 are already open. They may motivate this post-open diagnostic, but no v257 Case 19 field, residual, metric, pass count or gate value may be computed before this protocol and implementation closure are committed. The result cannot be called external confirmation.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: For each rig use the first nine stable IDs in the v209 order, then sort IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v248 frame-zero full-grid parser, float64 rectilinear interpolation, one-voxel zero support and active-cell mean gauge.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the synthetic observation and scores the four veto metrics only. It never enters K1, score construction, support selection, dilation, correction, controls, depth or stopping.

observable_support.seed: Run zero-start reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS K1 on the current canonical observation.
observable_support.score: On the one-voxel active interior, score_i = abs(x1_i)/sqrt(inverse_diagonal_i), equivalently abs(x1_i)*sqrt(normal_diagonal_i). Set boundary score exactly zero and square score for cumulative energy.
observable_support.selection: Sort active cells by descending squared score with ascending C-order flat index as the exact tie-break. Select the smallest prefix whose float64 cumulative energy is at least 0.95 of total active score energy.
observable_support.zero_mass: Non-positive or non-finite total score energy is invalid; no fallback is allowed.
observable_support.dilation: Apply exactly one six-neighbour voxel dilation (plus self), clipped to the frozen one-voxel active interior.
observable_support.masked_projection: M zeros cells outside the dilated mask and subtracts the arithmetic mean over selected cells. M is used on both the correction field and adjoint, so A_M z=A(Mz) and A_M^T r=M(A^T r).
observable_support.correction: Run zero-start identity-preconditioned CGLS K11 on A_M with observation equal to the exact K1 residual. Identity is required so every correction direction remains in range(M).
observable_support.warm_initializer: Add M(delta11) to x1, then apply the frozen full one-voxel support and active-cell mean gauge exactly once.
observable_support.final_stage: Run exactly one iteration of the unchanged full-field reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS recurrence from the warm initializer; its initializer projection is recomputed and charged.

unique_primary.name: canonical_camera_k1_geometry_whitened_energy95_dilate1_masked_cgls_k11_full_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k1
unique_primary.ledger: K1 seed 1A+1A^T; masked CGLS K11 11A+11A^T; full initializer projection and PCGLS K1 2A+1A^T.
unique_primary.offline_audit_calls_are_not_hidden: Masked-adjoint and physical residual replay probes are recorded separately and excluded from the logical online ledger.

control_boundary: No sealed directly comparable Case19 frame-zero dual-ridge arm exists. A PoolFire or another-case dual-ridge result is not imported as a fake same-data control. The four exact v244 solver controls are recomputed on the same thirteen cells.
forbidden_search: No energy fraction, score power, whitening exponent, tie-break, dilation count/connectivity, mask gauge, seed depth, correction depth, final depth, preconditioner, camera subset, rig, initializer, metric, threshold or fallback search is allowed after freeze. Do not substitute 90/97/99 percent, two dilations, connected components, morphology, another masked solve, v256 endpoints, a learned model or GPU training.

accuracy_gate.reference_role: K16 supplies the frozen per-metric matched denominator but is not required to pass every absolute cell; a regularized nonlinear candidate may legitimately improve a K16 tail while still being required to pass both absolute and K16-matched gates.
accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If any equal-or-cheaper exact solver control passes all thirteen absolute and K16-matched cells, active-support-specific headroom is not isolated.

independent_validation.method: A second program must rebuild observations and reported-geometry Jacobi, implement score ordering and six-neighbour dilation with scalar loops and explicit flat-index tie-breaking, independently implement M, A_M, K1/K11/K1 and all four controls without importing the formal active-support helper, seal predictions before reading formal scientific arrays, and recompute metrics, gates and ledgers.
independent_validation.residual_scale_note: Formal-independent residual differences are normalized by the original observation norm, not by the potentially tiny converged residual norm. This scale-aware contract was frozen before v257 Case19 execution and does not reinterpret v256.

decision_order: Any source, input, shape, finite, score, zero-mass, tie-break, support, dilation, projection, adjoint, permutation, call-ledger, replay, seal or formal-independent mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_OBSERVABLE_ACTIVE_SUPPORT_FRAME_ZERO_V257.

If the unique primary fails any of the thirteen absolute or K16-matched cells, conclude FAIL_CASE19_OBSERVABLE_ACTIVE_SUPPORT_FRAME_ZERO_V257 and close this exact 95-percent/dilate-one/K1-K11-K1 mechanism without a full sequence run.

If the primary passes all thirteen but any equal-or-cheaper control also passes all thirteen absolute and matched cells, conclude PASS_CASE19_FRAME_ZERO_BUT_ACTIVE_SUPPORT_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V257 and do not claim support-specific headroom.

Only if the primary passes 13/13 absolute and matched, all four controls remain incomplete, every ledger is exact and independent validation passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_OBSERVABLE_ACTIVE_SUPPORT_FRAME_ZERO_HEADROOM_V257 and authorize one separately frozen full 429-cell sequence gate.
failure_action: Close the exact geometry-whitened 95-percent energy support, one six-neighbour dilation, masked CGLS K11 and final full PCGLS K1 mechanism without changing selection, morphology, depths, preconditioner, controls or thresholds. Do not rescue with another active-support schedule, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or GPU.
